originality.rationale: Comparative full-text reading found no implication of the exact strict ordering between Hill-order optimal novelty fractions for this deterministic, single-advantaged-incumbent and one-distinct-entrant-per-step model. The cited articles establish selection/innovation effects, various diversity indices, and classical localization thresholds; those ingredients alone do not state the distinct model-specific global optimum theorem. An unexamined broader theorem remains possible.

value.rationale: A 2026 empirical repertoire paper identifies innovation overcoming directional copying selection, and a prior cultural-innovation paper compares Shannon and Simpson numerically. The complete all-fitness mathematical model shows two distinct exact finite innovation optima with a nonempty interval of conflicting diversification prescriptions, and situates both strictly before incumbent disappearance; this is motivated structural information beyond a textbook substitution.
